title: Hordoffii Mana Murtii
intro: Koridoorii aangoo keessatti namni sadarkaa olaanaa qabu tokko hojjetaa bareedinni isaa kan addunyaa biraa ta’e tokkotti jaalala jalqabe. Jaalalli kun taateewwan walduraa duubaan amanamummaa qoratan, dhugaa dhokataa mul’isan, fi dhuma irrattis qulqullummaa hojjetaan sun mirkaneessu akka uumaman taasiseera.
clues: Biyya laga Abbayyaa, masaraa dhiibbaa guddaa qabu keessa jiraadhe.
Dargaggeessi tokko mana koo seenee, argamuun isaa addunyaa koo tasgabbeesse.
Ani isa sossobuuf yaale, inni garuu Gooftaa isaatti maganfate.
Uffata isaa duubaan cicciree, garuu ragaan gowwoomsaa koo agarsiisa.
Oduu dubartoota kabajamoo sana callisuuf, walga’ii tokkotti isaan afeere, meeshaalee qara qaban harka isaanii keessa kaa’e.
Dhumarratti, mooticha duratti dhugaa jiru beekee, balleessaa koo ifatti himadheera.
arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
